# crowsnest

> One session that watches your other Claude Code sessions: who is busy, who is waiting on you, what each one just said, and how to ask one directly

- [crowsnest.rows](_autosummary/crowsnest.rows.html.md): How an item’s row is built and hashed: one value, taken whole by every surface that pins it.
- [crowsnest.said](_autosummary/crowsnest.said.html.md): When the thing an item quotes was said: its own time, taken from its own source.
